Continue the measured push as <Subject 2>'s fingertips meet the underside and both palms cautiously support it; <Subject 1> still grips one side, his brow tightening. He remains visible and delivers <Subject 1> (S1) [D5 @ 5.05-7.8s generated-clip] says, <d>[Chinese] 人血馒头！治痨病的好东西！</d> with synchronized Chinese lip movement in an impatient, assured manner while <Subject 2> draws the bun slowly toward his own side. <Subject 1> releases it and retracts his arm slightly; <Subject 2> secures it in one arm, then uses the freed hand to take the coin pouch from his front and open its mouth between them. During the same uninterrupted push, <Subject 1> leans slightly closer and shifts his gaze from the bun to the pouch. The opened pouch drops naturally against his front. <Subject 1> reaches in firmly and clamps his fingers around the silver dollar while <Subject 2> still supports its edge. Continue the instruction as <Subject 1> draws the coin cleanly into his palm; <Subject 2> releases it, withdraws that hand, and encloses the bun with both hands as the pouch settles against his clothing. Near the end of the instruction, ownership is unmistakable: the silver dollar is in <Subject 1>'s palm and the bun is enclosed by <Subject 2>.
